entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A human planeswalker and Gatewatch member, a hieromancer and sural wielder, who struggles over whether the Gatewatch should take sides in Kaladesh's conflict.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A human pyromancer, planeswalker and Gatewatch member, Pia Nalaar's daughter, who wants to help her mother and the renegades.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A death mage and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who hates Tezzeret and kills Consulate forces.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage planeswalker of the Gatewatch who shadows Consulate forces to uncover Tezzeret's plans.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker of the Gatewatch who tracks aether flow with Yahenni.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker with a blue eye who guards Pia and joins the diversion.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother and a renegade leader who plans the capture of the Aether Hub.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A metalsmith who replicates machines in filigree metal and discovers Tezzeret's hiding place.

entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: An aetherborn whose penthouse shelters the Gatewatch and who tracks aether flow with Nissa.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A dangerous artificer who controls and leads the Consulate and is hidden in a private workshop in the central Aether Spire.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Consulate figure who, with Tezzeret, would bring out big weapons against a renegade success.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: The winning inventor of the Fair and Saheeli's friend, held by Tezzeret.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers who each took an oath to keep watch over the Multiverse.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh, led by Tezzeret, enforcing a crackdown.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: Rebel groups on Kaladesh fighting the Consulate with Pia's guidance.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild Gideon fought for with his hieromancy.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrous enemies Gideon cut down on Zendikar and Innistrad.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A gleaming city of Kaladesh under crackdown.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where the Gatewatch is embroiled in a local political conflict.

entities.name: Yahenni's penthouse
entities.description: A tall penthouse that serves as the Gatewatch's base with a rooftop view of Ghirapur.

entities.name: Bomat District
entities.description: A district of Ghirapur where Gideon fights a Consulate charger and automaton.

entities.name: The Aether Spire
entities.description: The central spire holding Tezzeret's private workshop.

entities.name: The Aether Hub
entities.description: A hub diverting aether to the Spire's reservoir; the renegades plan to capture it.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Gideon fought for the Boros and Jace has a sanctum.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Where Liliana recalls Gideon cutting down Eldrazi.

entities.name: Weldfast
entities.description: Ghirapur district toward which Saheeli and Liliana head.

entities.name: Gideon's sural
entities.description: Gideon's weapon strapped to his right wrist.

entities.name: Consulate charger
entities.description: A Consulate vehicle Gideon stops with his body.

entities.name: Consulate automaton
entities.description: A twelve-foot steel-gray Consulate automaton with its power core in a standard location.

events.summary: Gideon weighs, over coffee, whether the Gatewatch should be taking sides in Kaladesh's local conflict.
events.quote: should the Gatewatch be taking sides in this local conflict ?

events.summary: A thopter signals Gideon that Pia has news, and he returns to Yahenni's penthouse.
On the roof, Gideon tells Chandra the Gatewatch came for her, not to topple the Consulate; Chandra accuses him of silence.
Chandra agrees to focus on stopping Tezzeret, while also helping her mother as Pia Nalaar's daughter.
events.quote: And, as much as I hate it, I'll try to focus on stopping Tezzeret....for now.

events.summary: Gideon confronts Liliana for killing Consulate forces; she argues death is a tool and they had to.
Liliana says there is just one person she wants to kill on this plane and tells Gideon Tezzeret destroyed something that was hers.
events.quote: "He hurt something important to me. Destroyed something that was mine."

events.summary: Gideon withstands a charging Consulate charger in Bomat and shields its driver.
A Consulate automaton knocks Gideon through a wall.
events.quote: a massive metallic fist slammed into Gideon, sending him flying and crashing through the wall of a nearby building.

events.summary: Saheeli reassembles scrap into replica automatons and uses a golden automaton to destroy the Consulate automaton.
events.quote: Saheeli pumped a fist in triumph.

events.summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
Saheeli reveals she has found where Tezzeret is hiding, in a private workshop in the central Aether Spire, where he holds the winning inventor.
events.quote: He has locked himself away in a private workshop, hidden in the central Aether Spire.

events.summary: Nissa and Yahenni confirm an unusual flux of aether is being diverted from the Aether Hub to the Spire's reservoir.
events.quote: Miss Nissa and I have recently determined an unusual flux of aether being diverted to that particular reservoir from the Aether Hub.

events.summary: Liliana volunteers to infiltrate with Saheeli; Gideon reluctantly agrees and tells her to do what is right.
Pia proposes the renegades capture the Aether Hub to cut power to the Spire, and reveals they have a big invention only needing aether.
Gideon assigns roles: Pia and Chandra mobilize the renegades while he, Nissa, Jace and Ajani create disruption against the Consulate.
events.quote: We're going to run disruption until the renegades are ready to begin the assault.

events.summary: Gideon persuades Chandra to lead by example for the renegades instead of joining the diversion.
events.quote: "Lead by example. Lead by your strength."

events.summary: Consulate forces arrive and Gideon readies to fight.

relations.note: Each took an oath to keep watch.
relations.quote: We each took an oath to keep watch.
He was here for Chandra. His friend.

relations.note: Tezzeret maintains control and leadership of the Consulate.
relations.quote: With Tezzeret still maintaining control and leadership of the Consulate
"Keep out of my way, and I will end him and this whole charade."

relations.note: Pia lays out the renegades' plans.
relations.quote: Just letting my mom talk and plan the renegades' next attacks

relations.note: Tezzeret holds the winning inventor captive.
relations.quote: He also has the winning inventor in his grasp.

relations.note: The Gatewatch now battles on the renegades' side.
relations.quote: They were why the Gatewatch now battled on the side of the renegade forces.
